paper_metadata.title: Revealing the Ta effect on γ’ phase coarsening behavior and mechanical properties in CoNi-based superalloys

evidence.quote: Due to excellent overall high-temperature performance, CoNi-based superalloys have drawn much attention as high-temperature structural materials.

The alloy ingot used in the experiment was prepared by vacuum arc melting furnace and cooled by water-cooled copper crucible under Ar gas atmosphere. The resulting ingot will be turned over and smelted 5 – 6 times to ensure that the obtained alloy composition is uniform.

The high temperature box furnace was used for solid solution treatment at 1250 ◦ C for 10 h, and the cooling method was air cooling to remove the coarse γ’ phase generated in the melting process and eliminate element segregation again to ensure the homogenization of alloy ingot elements.

Subsequently, the aging treatment was carried out at 900 ◦ C for 100 h, and the cooling method was air cooling, so as to measure the γ’ phase solvus temperature and element distribution of the alloy as a standard heat treatment.

conflicts.description: Ta effect on γ' phase coarsening is controversial: Qu et al. and Zhang et al. reported Ta reduces coarsening, while Li et al. and Xue et al. showed Ta accelerates coarsening.

evidence.quote: Qu [ 20 ] et al. and Zhang [ 21 ] et al. reported that Ta could reduce the γ’ phase coarsening of Co-based superalloys. However, the work of Li [ 22 ] et al. and Xue [ 23 ] et al. showed contrary demonstration that Ta could accelerate the γ’ phase coarsening via the increase in lattice misfit and interfacial energy.
